title: Ordering, delivery and returns
intro: This policy applies to every order placed on the {shopName} website. Please read it before you order.

blocks.p: You order directly on the website; no account is needed. Every cake is made for your order, so we need some time to prepare:

list: Orders under {largeThreshold} portions: at least {smallLead} hours ahead.
Orders of {largeThreshold} portions or more: at least {largeLead} hours ahead.
We can only make a limited number of portions each day. Fully booked days can't be chosen.

blocks.p: After ordering you get an order code. Use it with your phone number on the Track your order page to see how your order is doing.

list: Prices are in Vietnamese dong and do not include the delivery fee.
We accept bank transfers (scan the VietQR code). Cash on delivery is not available yet.
Please transfer the exact amount and use the transfer message shown after you order.
Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after {unpaidMinutes} minutes.
Your order is confirmed once we receive the payment.
We deliver to the areas listed when you order.
Cakes are delivered by third-party couriers (such as Grab or Ahamove). You pay the delivery fee directly to the driver.
Choose the earliest delivery today or a scheduled day and time. Delivery times may shift a little because of weather or traffic.
Please keep your phone nearby so the driver can reach you. If the driver can't reach you and the cake comes back, we will contact you to arrange another delivery; the extra delivery fee is yours.

blocks.p: Our cakes are fresh food made for each order, so we can't accept returns or give refunds for a change of mind.
If something is wrong with your cake, we will make you a fresh one or give you a discount code for next time, when:

list: You received the wrong cake, the wrong flavor, or something is missing.
The cake was damaged or badly squashed when you received it.
The cake shows signs of a quality problem.

blocks.p: How to tell us: contact us within 2 hours of receiving the cake, with your order code and a photo. Please keep the cake until we reply.
If we cancel an order you have paid for (for example, an ingredient ran out or we can't deliver), we refund the full amount to the account you paid from within 3 working days.

list: Before paying: simply don't transfer the money and the order cancels itself.
After paying: we have already prepared ingredients for your order, so we can't refund a cancellation for a change of mind. Contact us to move the delivery day if the new day has room.
Store and enjoy each cake as described on its page.

Ingredients and allergens are listed on each cake's page. Our kitchen uses milk, eggs, wheat flour and nuts, so we can't fully rule out cross-contact. If you have a serious allergy, please ask us before ordering.

blocks.p: Send feedback or complaints via: {contactLine}. We reply within 24 hours (during opening hours).
